diary.ashore: OFF THE BOAT AND HUNGRY ALREADY
diary.dues: PAID MY WAY IN. FAIR'S FAIR.
diary.leaving: OFF TO THE BOAT. GOOD MUD AHEAD.
diary.missedboat: MISSED THE BOAT. MORE FOR ME.
diary.checkin: ROOM {N} AT THE DRIFTWOOD. THAT'LL DO.
diary.checkout: UP WITH THE SUN. SLEPT LIKE A HOG.
diary.rough: SLEPT ROUGH. DONE WORSE AT HARVEST.
diary.turnin: FULL DAY. STRAIGHT TO THE HAY.
diary.gaveup: GAVE UP ON THE {BIZ}. LIFE'S SHORT.

depart.rough: A BEACH IS NO BED. EVEN OUR MUD IS WARMER.
depart.quits: WALKED OUT OF EVERY LINE. I'D RATHER SHOVEL.
depart.quit: STOOD AT THE {BIZ} TIL MY FEET GAVE UP.
depart.nothing: ALL THAT WAY FOR SHUT DOORS AND SEA AIR.
depart.unspent: TAKING ${LEFT} HOME. NOTHING HERE TO SPEND IT ON.
depart.idle: MONEY LEFT OVER AND NOTHING I WANTED. ODD PLACE.
depart.hungry: LEAVING HUNGRIER THAN THE HARVEST LEFT ME.
depart.parched: DRY AS AUGUST. NOT A DROP ALL DAY.
depart.grubby: SAND IN MY BRISTLES AND NO TUB IN TOWN.
depart.weary: DEAD ON MY TROTTERS. NO HAY IN THIS TOWN.
depart.bored: SEEN THE SEA. THAT WAS THE WHOLE SHOW.
depart.wait: WAITED {MINS} FOR A PLATE. ATE IT ANYWAY.
depart.dues: PAID AT THE PLANK. STEEP, FOR PLANKS.
depart.missed: MISSED THE BOAT. THE HAY WILL WAIT.
depart.mist: THE MIST ATE THE VIEW. SMELLED LIKE HOME.
depart.table: WAITED ON AT A TABLE. LIKE A PRIZE HOG.
depart.bed: THAT DRIFTWOOD BED BEAT MY OWN HAYLOFT.
depart.spentup: SPENT THE LOT. THAT'S WHAT MONEY'S FOR.
depart.top: PAID PROPER FOR A {ITEM}. WORTH EVERY CENT.
depart.regular: ATE WELL, SLEPT WELL, PAID FAIR. GOOD TOWN.
depart.quiet: QUIET PLACE. GOOD FOR NAPS, LITTLE ELSE.
depart.delight: A PROPER BUN AT LAST. I'D SAIL BACK FOR ANOTHER.

dossier: CAME FOR THE FOOD, STAYING FOR THE FOOD
BACK HOME, THE PIGTATOR. HERE, GULLS.
THE SEA'S BIGGER THAN THEY SAID
registers.foreign: NOT A PORK BUN IN TOWN. I ATE FISH, I SUPPOSE.
registers.refuseHire: KIND OFFER. BUT MY FIELDS WON'T PLOW THEMSELVES.

diary.leaving: PROCEEDING TO THE FERRY AS SCHEDULED
diary.missedboat: THE BOAT LEFT EARLY. I DID NOT.
diary.checkout: CHECKED OUT. THE LEDGER IS SETTLED.
diary.wokesand: WOKE UNHOUSED. A SECOND NOTE IS MADE.

depart.rough: THE PIGPUBLIC WILL HEAR OF THE SAND I SLEPT ON.
depart.quits: I WITHDREW FROM EVERY QUEUE. SO FILED.
depart.nothing: EVERY DOOR SHUT. I SHALL SAY SO IN MY REPORT.
depart.unspent: ${LEFT} OF MY ${PURSE} RETURNS UNSPENT TO THE MAINLAND.
depart.idle: FUNDS REMAIN. THE TOWN LACKED AMBITION.
depart.hungry: I DEPART UNFED. THE REPORT WILL BE FRANK.
depart.parched: NO REFRESHMENT WAS SECURED. DULY NOTED.
depart.grubby: I ARRIVE HOME UNBATHED. MOST IRREGULAR.
depart.weary: NO BED WAS PROVIDED. I REMAINED UPRIGHT.
depart.wait: SERVED AFTER {MINS}. I STOOD ON PRINCIPLE.
depart.dues: TAXED AT THE PLANK. AN INVOICE FOLLOWS.
depart.missed: THE SAILING WAS MISSED. INQUIRIES PROCEED.
depart.mist: VISIBILITY POOR. THE FAR SHORE UNVERIFIED.
depart.bed: THE DRIFTWOOD KEEPS A BED FIT FOR A CONSUL.
depart.spentup: SPENT EVERY DOLLAR OF MY ${PURSE}. QUITE CORRECT.
depart.top: THE {ITEM} WAS ACCEPTABLE. PAID IN FULL.
depart.regular: {STOPS} STOPS IN {DAYS} DAYS. THE PIGPUBLIC APPROVES.
depart.quiet: A SEA VIEW AND LITTLE ELSE. SO NOTED.
depart.delight: THE BUN WAS CORRECT. THE REPORT WILL SAY SO.

dossier: MY PAPERS ARE ENTIRELY IN ORDER
TRAVELING BY LEAVE OF THE PIGTATOR
HERE IN A STRICTLY PRIVATE CAPACITY
registers.foreign: NOTHING ON ANY MENU A PIG WOULD RECOGNIZE.
registers.refuseHire: AN APRON? I HOLD A CLERKSHIP, MADAM.
